text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: SEV-2 - Aurora Health (enterprise-vpc) experiencing websocket streaming timeouts and elevated retry rates across their dedicated pool. Affected: streaming sessions 10-20% failing, increased client retries. Pager: @oncall-ryan :rotating_light:

oncall-ryan: I'm awake, looking now. Can someone confirm which pool and any recent deploys?

sara_eng: Aurora is on dedicated-pool-aurora-3 in us-west-2. No infra deploys in last 2 hrs. We did push a small model weights rollout earlier today but that was to hosted models, not dedicated.

james_sre: I'm seeing spike in 502/504 on the gateway side for streaming websocket endpoints. Retry burst from client side causing connection churn.

emily_customer_success: Aurora reports timeouts starting ~15:10 UTC, some users seeing repeated reconnect loops. They flagged a downstream appgateway proxy change earlier at 15:05.

oncall-ryan: OK. @maria_platform can you check routing and any autoscaler events for dedicated-pool-aurora-3?

maria_platform: Checking now - autoscaler did a scale-up attempt at 15:12 but it failed due to quota hit on node group (NVIDIA quota). Logs: `autoscaler: scaleUp failed: quotaExceeded`.

aurora_infra: we rolled an appgw config at 15:05 to tighten idle timeout to 10s (was 60s) to reduce hanging connections. Might be aggressive for LLM streaming. Apologies, we didn't coordinate the timeout change with Redwood.

oncall-ryan: That lines up. Short idle timeout + client retries -> frequent WS reconnects, KV cache cold starts, increased token generation and upstream load. Let's mitigate: 1) Temporarily increase gateway idle timeout back to 60s 2) Throttle client retry window at gateway 3) Add short-term routing to fallback HTTP streaming endpoint for Aurora while we stabilize.

emily_customer_success: I'll ask Aurora to revert the change immediately. Maria, can we add alternate route to HTTP streaming?

maria_platform: I can push a route rule to allow `streaming.fallback=true` to route Aurora traffic to http-stream-proxy cluster. Need a 2-min window for rollout.

james_sre: While that's happening, I'll open a temporary rate-limit on the dedicated pool to 50 rps for Aurora tenant to avoid thrashing. Command I'm going to run:
```
redwoodctl rate-limit create --tenant aurora --pool dedicated-pool-aurora-3 --limit 50
```
Expect effect within ~30s.

deploy-bot: Started job #deploy-8743: route-add/aurora-fallback (maria_platform).

maria_platform: Route rule applied. Aurora traffic now routing to http-stream-proxy fallback cluster. Monitoring for errors.

james_sre: Rate-limit applied. Starting to see connection failures drop on the pool side. Token rate backpressure reduced.

oncall-ryan: Aurora reverted their appgw idle-timeout to 60s. Confirming with customer.

emily_customer_success: Aurora confirms revert done at 15:28 UTC. They're seeing far fewer reconnects now.

james_sre: Good. I'm also enabling a temporary reconnection-backoff header injection for Aurora clients via edge config to encourage exponential backoff: `X-Client-Backoff: 2000` (ms base).

sara_eng: Noted. I'm standing by to assist with KV cache warmup if we see quality regressions after reconnects. Could warm cached prefixes for top 50 sessions if needed.

maria_platform: Monitoring metrics: websocket_open_errors down from 18% -> 3% in last 4m. Downstream latency stable.

oncall-ryan: Nicely handled. Next steps: - Keep fallback route for 20m, then evaluate removing once stable - Follow up with Aurora infra to coordinate future gateway config changes - File incident postmortem and customer-facing notes - Remove temporary rate-limit once backpressure gone

emily_customer_success: I'll draft a short customer note to Aurora: apology + summary + ETA for final resolution.

james_sre: I'll leave the rate-limit in place for another 10m then re-evaluate. Also creating ticket: INC-2026-341 for root cause/action items.

oncall-ryan: Handoff to oncall-squad for monitoring. @james_sre please take incident lead for postmortem and liaise with Aurora infra. I'll go back to rotation but available if escalation.

james_sre: Ack. I'll collect logs, attach graphs (ws-errors, reconnect-rate, token-rate) and schedule a 1:1 with Aurora infra.

emily_customer_success: Customer note drafted and sent. They appreciate quick mitigation.

maria_platform: Reverting route to normal in 22m unless we see regression.

deploy-bot: job #deploy-8743 completed: route-add/aurora-fallback SUCCESS.

james_sre: Final update before I lock this: current status - streaming errors reduced to pre-incident baseline, dedicated pool healthy, autoscaler quota issue still open (need quota request to cloud). Action items: 1) apply cloud GPU quota request (ops) 2) add alert for appgw idle-timeout config drift for enterprise tenants 3) document recommended idle-timeout >= 30s for LLM WebSocket streaming 4) customer postmortem meeting scheduled.

oncall-ryan: Closing active page. If anything flares, re-page using SEV-2. Good job team. :tada:
